logline: 어느 날 고기를 먹지 않기로 한 아내를 세 사람의 눈으로 보는 한강의 장편 — 식탁의 전쟁과 식물의 언어
setting: 2000년대 서울의 아파트 — 부엌과 식탁, 창가, 그리고 초록빛 숲
anchor: a slim Korean woman in her early thirties with long straight black hair, a pale still face, in a plain grey house dress
palette: off-white, deep green, ash grey, dark brown, dull red

beats.beat: 서울의 평범한 부부 집 — 저녁 식탁
beats.visual: the dining table of the Seoul apartment at dusk set for two, two bowls of rice, a dish of grilled meat, the window showing other apartment blocks with lit windows; no people
beats.motion: steam rises slowly from the two bowls and the lit windows of the far blocks flicker on one by one; the camera holds on the set table

beats.beat: 어느 날의 꿈 — 잠 못 드는 아내
beats.visual: night in the bedroom of the apartment, the wife lying awake on her back with her eyes wide open, the husband asleep beside her with his back turned, the blue light of the window on the ceiling; exactly two people
beats.motion: the wife's open eyes stay fixed on the ceiling while the husband's back rises and sinks in sleep; the camera holds on the two in the bed

beats.visual: morning in the kitchen, the wife kneeling before the open refrigerator dropping wrapped packs of meat into a black plastic bag, the husband standing in the kitchen doorway in his shirt with his mouth open; exactly two people
beats.motion: the wife's hands keep dropping the wrapped packs into the bag one after another and the husband's open mouth holds in the doorway; the camera holds on the open refrigerator

beats.visual: the wife seated at the dining table with an empty white plate before her and her hands in her lap, three relatives seated around her with their chopsticks stopped in the air, dishes of meat in the middle; exactly four people
beats.motion: the three pairs of chopsticks stay stopped in the air and the wife's eyes stay on the empty plate; the camera holds on the table

beats.beat: 세 사람의 눈 — 젓가락 세 벌
beats.visual: the dining table seen from directly above, one untouched white plate in the centre and three pairs of chopsticks laid around it pointing at the plate; no people
beats.motion: the light across the table shifts slowly and the three pairs of chopsticks hold their places around the plate; the camera holds from above on the table

beats.beat: 아무도 아내가 되지 못한다 — 창가의 아내
beats.visual: the wife standing alone at the balcony window with her back to the room, her forehead close to the glass, looking at a single tree between the apartment blocks; exactly one woman
beats.motion: the wife's breath fogs a small patch of the glass and the tree outside sways slightly; the camera holds on the woman at the window

beats.visual: close on the wife's two open hands held up in the green light from the balcony plants, the shadows of leaves lying across her palms; exactly one woman
beats.motion: the leaf shadows drift slowly across the open palms as the plants stir; the camera holds close on the hands

beats.visual: the wife lying on her side on the floor of the living room with her eyes open, stripes of afternoon sunlight from the blinds across her body, potted plants on the windowsill; exactly one woman
beats.motion: the sunlight stripes creep slowly across the wife's body as the afternoon passes, her open eyes unmoving; the camera holds on the woman on the floor

beats.visual: close on a glass of water on the dining table with a single green leaf floating in it, the window light through the glass throwing a wavering patch on the tablecloth; no people
beats.motion: the leaf turns slowly in the water and the patch of light wavers on the cloth; the camera holds close on the glass

beats.beat: 2016년 인터내셔널 부커상 — 세계가 읽은 서울의 방
beats.visual: the wife seated on the edge of the bed in the plain grey dress with her hands folded, the room bare, the window showing the apartment blocks at dusk; exactly one woman
beats.motion: the dusk light in the window fades slowly and the wife's folded hands stay still; the camera holds on the seated woman

beats.visual: the sister standing in the kitchen doorway looking into the dim living room, one hand on the door frame, the wife's empty chair at the table in front of her; exactly one woman
beats.motion: the sister's hand tightens on the door frame and her eyes stay on the empty chair; the camera holds on the sister in the doorway

beats.visual: close on the dining table: a man's hand pushing a bowl of meat across the cloth toward a woman's thin hand, the thin hand flat on the table with the fingers drawn back; exactly two hands
beats.motion: the man's hand pushes the bowl a little further and the thin fingers draw back further from it; the camera holds close on the two hands

beats.visual: a bare dry branch standing in a vase on the dining table, the wife's still figure blurred behind it at the window, the room grey; exactly one woman
beats.motion: the wife's blurred figure stays still behind the branch while the grey light shifts on the table; the camera holds on the dry branch

beats.visual: the wife standing barefoot among the tall straight trees of the wood in her plain grey dress, her arms lifted a little from her sides and her face turned up to the green light; exactly one woman
beats.motion: the green light through the leaves moves slowly over the wife's lifted arms and upturned face, the ferns stirring; the camera holds on the woman among the trees

beats.visual: closing still: the dining table with one chair pulled back, an empty white plate with a single green leaf on it, the window light grey on the tablecloth
beats.motion: the grey light shifts slowly across the tablecloth and the leaf on the plate holds still; the camera closes with great patience on the empty plate
